text: We definitely don't need full transcriptions in the dashboard. That's definitely more prompt log level stuff. However, if I'm currently transcribing, it probably should appear on the dashboard. But I think what should happen there is that it should start as a transcription card, and then it morphs into a summary card. And so at first it's a rough idea, and I'm just fleshing it out. And then the transcription appears on screen just so I know it got there and that everything is working. And then as you start working with it and processing it, we adapt, I don't need to see the full transcription anymore if we can refine it and make it better. Although that's maybe a tricky process. Now what I'm thinking is we probably want a two column paging system for the AI dashboard. So on AI v3, we want to have two columns, two equal columns. By the way, these cards need more padding. Should we be using the standard pad that automatically scales with the size of the container? Didn't we create a whole mastermind about container query units and using the proper padding? This is great.
